comments.author: @AlexFletcher-r3k
comments.text: The Mississippi is a fraud.  At Cairo, the Ohio brings in a greater volume of water, but the main stem is called the Mississippi due to it's greater length above the confluence.  At St. Louis, The Missouri has the greater upstream length, but the main stem is still called the Mississippi because it contributes the larger flow.  Anyone else see a problem here? I smell ref ball.

comments.author: @fastfreddy3103
comments.text:
At Cairo the Ohio and Mississippi seem about the same size to my eye. The whole system could have been called the Ohio. 
Same with the Columbia and Snake at Sacajawea SP. in Washington State. 
My fav is the Green River of Wyoming. Joins the Colorado in Canyonlands NP. Rises in the Wind River Mts. The Yampa joins it at Echo Park after the damed Flaming Gorge. The Yampa is the last free flowing river in the lower’48. I have been to all these places including the Yukon. 
Thanks, good stuff.
